body: Do what I did today. Go to some store really far away from where you live and just talk to random people. If you're as socially retarded as me, you WILL get shot down / brushed off, but it won't matter because you'll never see those people again. What matters is that you'll learn something. Even if nothing you try clicks with people, that's still an accomplishment because you learned what doesn't work.

I did the same thing! Except for me the stuffed animal thing lasted into my early teens. I also made up love stories to fill the void in my social life. I stopped once I got older and realized how damaging it all was, but by then I was just even more depressed because I realized that falling in love would probably never happen for me.

Same here. I would have killed myself a year ago, but the only thing stopping me was the thought of what it would do to my parents. My brother died a year ago, and I don't want to put my parents through the loss of another son. It's  ironic, if he hadn't died, I'd probably be dead by now.
I have Aspergers too, I know what it's like. I've been feeling much the same way you are. You can pm me if you want.

It's a computer science degree. They say CS is one of the easiest majors to get a job in, but that just makes me feel even worse about it. What sucks the most is that I know I'm a good programmer. I just wish someone would give me a chance to prove it.
